claims.quote: For a new text analytics application requiring feature engineering, it starts with estimating its semantic proximity (from the perspective of a NLP data scientist) with existing applications with known features.
claims.text: For a new application, the system first estimates its semantic proximity with existing applications in the knowledge base that have known features (by embedding the new application's fields and computing field-level similarities, with the mean similarity across fields serving as the proximity).

claims.quote: Next, create a degree-1 ego-similarity network for $NewP$ to represent how close is $NewP$ with existing applications in $APPS$.
claims.text: The closeness of the new application to each existing application is captured in an ego-similarity network (diagonal matrix), which is then combined with the feature relevance matrix to estimate the probable relevance of each feature for the new application.
